upstream.scope: Generic macOS client: every window of a session shows the connection status as client-owned chrome (NSWindow.subtitle and the window's accessibility help) that no server property writes, driven by ConnectionManager from ConnectionStatus for the current attempt generation only (§17, §18, §22.3, §22.8; D2 T22–T24, T38); no server, SDK, protocol, registry, proto or framing change and no srtop change

entries.feature: AppKitRenderer.setSessionWindowStatus(_:) / sessionWindowStatus: one client-owned status line on every Surface window as NSWindow.subtitle and window accessibility help; never writes or is written by the server-owned title (Surface label -> NSWindow.title); kept by the renderer and applied to every Surface window mount(nodeID:from:) creates, so it survives remounts and reaches windows created later; nil or empty clears it

ConnectionManager drives the session-window status from ConnectionStatus through one writer (setStatus): connecting, resynchronizing and disconnected name the last applied revision as stale, a REPLACED decision says the session is rebuilding, ready clears it; only the current attempt generation reaches it, and it is cleared before a session context is dropped
entries.scope: PX-022-G01/client-macos ConnectionManager/ConnectionManager.swift ConnectionStatus.sessionWindowStatus(lastAppliedRevision:), setStatus, discardContext; SRUITests ConnectionManagerTests
